lines.text: Zechariah sees a flying scroll twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.
The scroll is the curse going out over all the land, and every thief and every perjurer will be removed.
The LORD of Hosts says the curse will enter the thief's house and destroy it, timbers and stones.
The angel says a measuring basket is going forth, and the woman inside is Wisdom, shoved under the lead cover.
Two winged women lift the basket between heaven and earth to build it a house in the land of Goshen.
